answer: As of June 2026, Saturn has 293 confirmed moons. This represents the latest confirmed count, making Saturn the planet with the most moons in our Solar System, far exceeding Jupiter's 115 confirmed moons.
sources: Web search 'how many confirmed moons does Saturn have 2026' - 285 in March 2026, 292 in April 2026, 293 as of June 2026
